package consumer

// Comparison fixture only: the explicit DTO/setter/Form-to-builder pattern
// used by Article at 82142bbf. It is not a production compatibility adapter.
import (
	"errors"

	"example.com/godj-project-bundle/inventory"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api"
	bodyinput "github.com/progresshans/godj/api/input"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/auth"
	formmodel "github.com/progresshans/godj/forms/model"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/serializers"
)

type manualInput struct {
	code    bodyinput.Presence[string]
	enabled bodyinput.Presence[bool]
	note    bodyinput.Presence[*string]
}

func manualBody(spec serializers.Spec) (bodyinput.Body[manualInput], error) {
	return bodyinput.New(spec, api.ParserConfig{},
		bodyinput.Field("code", bodyinput.String(), func(value *manualInput, field bodyinput.Presence[string]) { value.code = field }),
		bodyinput.Field("enabled", bodyinput.Boolean(), func(value *manualInput, field bodyinput.Presence[bool]) { value.enabled = field }),
		bodyinput.Field("note", bodyinput.Nullable(bodyinput.String()), func(value *manualInput, field bodyinput.Presence[*string]) { value.note = field }),
	)
}

func (input manualInput) create(workspace int64) inventory.AssetCreate {
	code, _ := input.code.Get()
	result := inventory.NewAssetCreate(code, workspace)
	if value, present := input.enabled.Get(); present {
		result = result.WithEnabled(value)
	}
	if value, present := input.note.Get(); present {
		if value == nil {
			result = result.WithNoteNull()
		} else {
			result = result.WithNote(*value)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func (input manualInput) patch() inventory.AssetPatch {
	result := inventory.AssetPatch{}
	if value, present := input.code.Get(); present {
		result = result.WithCode(value)
	}
	if value, present := input.enabled.Get(); present {
		result = result.WithEnabled(value)
	}
	if value, present := input.note.Get(); present {
		if value == nil {
			result = result.WithNoteNull()
		} else {
			result = result.WithNote(*value)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func manualFormCreate(bound formmodel.BoundForm, workspace int64) (inventory.AssetCreate, error) {
	values, err := bound.Input()
	if err != nil {
		return inventory.AssetCreate{}, err
	}
	code, ok := values.String("code")
	if !ok {
		return inventory.AssetCreate{}, errors.New("missing code")
	}
	enabled, ok := values.Boolean("enabled")
	if !ok {
		return inventory.AssetCreate{}, errors.New("missing enabled")
	}
	result := inventory.NewAssetCreate(code, workspace).WithEnabled(enabled)
	note, present := values.Get("note")
	if !present {
		return inventory.AssetCreate{}, errors.New("missing note")
	}
	if note.IsNull() {
		result = result.WithNoteNull()
	} else {
		text, ok := note.AsString()
		if !ok {
			return inventory.AssetCreate{}, errors.New("invalid note")
		}
		result = result.WithNote(text)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func manualPermission() auth.Permission { return "inventory.change_asset" }
func manualResponseFields() []string    { return []string{"id", "code", "enabled", "note"} }
